div.head: ECf retr 4
div.ab: De uniuersis tenentibus de ecclesia. Quicunque de ecclesia aliquid tenuerit uel in fundo ecclesie mansionem habuerit, extra curiam ecclesiasticam coactus non placitabit, quamuis forisfecerit, nisi — quod absit! — in curia ecclesiastica rectum defecerit.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 630 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page; the words in bold are the Retractator’s changes to ECf, as Liebermann prints them.

div.ab: Of all who hold of the Church. Whoever holds anything of the Church or has a dwelling on the Church's land shall not be compelled to plead outside the ecclesiastical court, even if he has committed an offence, unless — which God forbid! — he has failed of right in the ecclesiastical court.
